name: search
description: Search the indexed codebase and docs for relevant code or documentation.

name: get_stats
description: Return index health, chunk counts, model status, cache hit rates, and graph edge stats for the current workspace.

name: get_file_content
description: Read source for a specific file or symbol, with line-range support.

name: get_repo_structure
description: Return the live directory tree of the workspace.

name: get_git_diff
description: Show file-level changes between two git refs, or between HEAD and the working tree.

name: decision_create
description: Create a new Architecture Decision Record (ADR) in proposed state.

name: decision_update
description: Transition an existing ADR's status: accept, deprecate, or reinstate.

name: decision_supersede
description: Link two existing ADRs so the new one supersedes the old.

name: decision_list
description: List Architecture Decision Records with optional status filter.

name: decision_search
description: Semantic search over Architecture Decision Records to find relevant design rationale.

name: get_temporal_context
description: Return commit history, git blame, change velocity, and linked ADRs for a code entity.

name: graph_traverse
description: Walk the code graph outward or inward from a known entity across multiple hops.

name: graph_get_entity_callers
description: Return all entities that directly call or import a specific entity.

name: graph_get_entity_definition
description: Fetch source code, location, author, and commit metadata for a single named code entity.

name: graph_find_path
description: Find the shortest dependency path between two code entities.

name: graph_impact
description: Blast-radius analysis: find every entity that breaks if a given entity is deleted, renamed, or has its signature changed.

name: graph_stats
description: Return aggregate graph statistics: entity count, edge count, density, type/predicate breakdowns.

name: graph_query
description: Run a read-only WHERE-clause filter against the entity graph for bulk lookup by property.

name: nexus_search
description: Deep semantic search returning enriched nodes with code, structural edges, authorship, and temporal context in one call.

name: graph_at_time
description: Retrieve a bitemporal snapshot of an entity and its graph neighborhood as they existed at a specific commit or timestamp.

name: co_change_analysis
description: Find entities that historically co-change with a given entity across commits, surfacing undeclared coupling.

name: get_doctor
description: Run a full Contextual system diagnostic across models, index, retrieval pipeline, graph, database, MCP daemon, and git.

name: get_telemetry
description: Return recent activity and performance data for this workspace: tool-call volume, error counts, and latency percentiles.

name: diagnose_issue
description: Correlate a live health snapshot with recent telemetry into one ranked list of likely causes.
